item.title: 'Is it a perfect bill? No...but it’s the bill that we can get right now': US Senate passes legislation to get data centers to pay more for grid infrastructure — but many think it could have gone further

item.title: US financial crimes bureau discloses ‘cybersecurity incident’
item.description: The Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) disclosed on Tuesday that it's investigating a "cybersecurity incident." The bureau, which is part of the Treasury Department, said it's looking into an "incident that resulted in unauthorized access to a limited subset of its systems." It hasn't offered any information about the full scope or source of the […]...

item.description: Rockstar Games aimed to perfect the Grand Theft Auto 6's accessibility features so the experience feels as "inclusive" and "immersive" as possible.

item.title: Yale’s Sonnenfeld: Nvidia is a ‘detriment’ to U.S. industrial might — not a champion
item.description: Yale's Jeffrey Sonnenfeld warns that what the market cheered Monday, Jensen Huang's White House–backed return as Nvidia's CEO and board member, could prove a giant mistake, exposing the directors to "historic" personal liability from a growing pile of lawsuits and raising the question of whether the country is celebrating a company that has helped put advanced chips in its adversaries' hands....

item.title: Trump reportedly says pardoning Jensen Huang is ‘an option’
item.description: Huang faces ongoing questions about his relationship with Alice Huang, an executive with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence who previously worked for a company that has been accused of illegally diverting Nvidia chips to China.
